accepts.because: run a cycle NOW rather than at the next tick -- a cost alert or a DLQ spike is a reason not to wait for the clock

a model package for this hive's model call, pushed by the colony's llm-registry (GH #858): a PARAMS-ONLY body -- an empty `system` slot, no `messages` -- that the llm cell merges into its live params and answers with nothing. It goes from this path straight to `./judge`, the one llm cell of this hive, past every other cell, because a params body is not a request. The llm cell takes package keys from a params-only message only (GH #853), so no request on another lane can change the model it runs on. Draw it only from the registry's `update` lane, restamped `in_model`

the counts a curator answered to this hive's `stats` question: body `{messages: [], stats: {from, to, counts, samples, truncated}}`, `hop.stats_tag` echoing the ask. It goes to `./meter` and nowhere else, and it is matched to its ask by the tag alone -- an answer whose tag names no open ask is dropped without a word, and an ask nobody answered is closed by the next tick as `stats_unanswered`. A parent that draws no edge back gets a loop whose role goals never measure

the verdict of an evaluation batch on one proposed text change: body `{messages: [], eval: {verdict, batch_id, n, baseline, candidate, delta_pct}}`, `hop.eval_tag` echoing the order. It goes to `./mutator`, which applies the change only on a `pass` over a batch at least `max(eval_min_batch, min_samples)` large that moves the metric past the goal's floor, and discards it otherwise. An order nobody answered is discarded by the next tick as `eval_unanswered`

another part of the colony reads this hive's record: `hop.read_what` names the charter (`goals` and `rules` rows, each with its `table`), the cycle receipts or the hints; `read_since` (RFC 3339) pages cycles and hints oldest first, `read_limit` is 1..100 (default 20), `read_tag` is echoed. Rows come as stored, every column. The lane decides nothing: `./door` only reads, and a read starts no cycle. Without an edge onto it nobody reads

a hypothesis from another part of the colony, in the body slot `hint: {origin, confidence, line}` -- a slot, never a turn: `origin` `[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`, `confidence` a JSON integer 0..100, `line` one line of 1..500 characters after trimming. `./door` stores it in the receipts' `hints` table and does nothing else: no edge leads from the door into the loop, so a hint triggers no cycle; the loop shows it to its judge at the earliest in its next cycle, marked as a hypothesis, and a hint never counts as a measurement -- a change resting on hints alone still needs its evidence. Without an edge onto it nobody is heard

emits.because: the change this loop decided on, as an ordinary params update -- body `{system:{}, params:{...}}`, hop.target naming the cell it belongs to. The parent draws one edge per cell the loop may reach, so what is in range is a fact about the seed

a watched symptom crossed zero and no model was asked about it -- the metric, the goal that watched for it, the count and the window it was counted over. This is the whole of what an `observe` goal does when it sees something, and it is deliberately not a decision: a control loop that reacts to a symptom without a hypothesis is a random walk with receipts. A parent that draws no edge for it gets the receipt and no alert, which is a legitimate way to run it.
a step of the cycle could not complete; which step it was is this hive business, that it failed is the caller business

a model package pushed through `in_model` that `./judge` refused (GH #863): its error, with the judge's own path in `hop.refused_subscriber` and the model the push named in `hop.refused_model`, leaves here instead of reaching `./mutator` as a verdict -- before 1.2.1 the judge's out-edge was unconditional, so a refusal was read as a decision. A push addressed to another cell is refused as `invalid_input` without the two keys and still reaches the verdict edge -- the forward that caused it is the defect. `meclaw-os` carries it back to its registry's `in_refused` lane; a parent without that edge dead-letters it `no_route`, loudly

a question to a curator about its own ledger, for a goal whose `source` names a role: `hop.stats_role`, `hop.stats_tag`, `hop.stats_from`/`stats_to` (RFC 3339, the goal's window), `hop.stats_kinds` (a JSON array as text) and `hop.stats_samples`, body `{messages: []}`. The parent draws it to an assistant's stats lane and brings the answer back as `in_stats`; a parent that draws none gets role goals that are receipted as unanswered on every tick and never judged

one proposed text change, sent to an evaluator before anything is applied: body `{messages: [], eval: {cycle_id, target, key, from, to, batch_min}}`, `hop.eval_tag` naming the order. The cycle stays `open` as `eval_pending` until the verdict comes back on `in_eval`. Without an edge for it no text change is ever applied -- every one is discarded as unanswered, which is the safe way for this lane to be missing

a text change that passed its evaluation batch, or the way back from one: body `{messages: [], slot: {name, text}}`, `hop.target` naming the cell and `hop.cycle_id` the cycle, so the health check can see it arrive. The parent draws one edge per cell whose text the loop may reach, exactly like `mutate`; a text slot has no receiver unless one is drawn

the answer to `in_read`: body `{messages: [], rows: [...], next_since}` -- `next_since` is the `at` of the last row delivered, the cursor for the next page, empty for the charter or an empty page -- with `hop.read_tag` and `hop.read_what` echoed and `hop.error_code` empty, `invalid_input` (`hop.detail` names the hop key) or `store_error` (`hop.detail` carries the store's reason). A failed read is never an empty page

the answer to `in_hint`: `hop.hint_id` of the stored hint and an empty `hop.error_code`, or `invalid_hint` with `hop.detail` naming the field and nothing stored, or `store_error`. An acknowledgement says the hint is kept, not that anything will be done about it

description.purpose: Scope marker of the argus hive: the colony's control loop and its watcher. Charter -> measure -> judge (and simulate) -> params update to the named cell -> health check -> measure the effect -> keep or revert -> receipt. EVERY tick leaves a receipt, the tick that found nothing enabled and the cycle that died at a store reject included, so the table is a chain rather than a list of the moments something was decided. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS: `params.ports` is empty, so no edge reaches a cell in here; a caller names the hive and a lane on `hop.route`.
description.use_when: Once per colony, under /colony's sibling level. The charter ships every goal DISABLED, so a freshly grown argus changes nothing until somebody turns a row on -- it does still tick, and every one of those ticks is receipted as `idle`, because a loop whose clock has stopped and a loop with an empty charter must not write the same nothing.
description.not_in_scope: No operator lane -- a change leaves as an ordinary message and only reaches a cell a human wired an edge to. No mutation at all, in fact: nothing in here authors a diff, so the loop cannot add, remove or rewire a cell. No topology change either: the radius is model choice, numeric params and text slots, and a topology proposal is recorded for a human rather than executed. And no second bookkeeping: what it measures, it reads out of the substrate's own ledger, read-only.
description.contract_in: Three lanes, at the hive path. in_cycle -- run a cycle now instead of waiting for the clock. in_stats -- a curator's counts, answering the meter's `stats` question. in_eval -- an evaluator's verdict on one text change, answering the mutator's `eval` order. Which cell starts or resumes a cycle is this hive's business.
description.contract_out: Six lanes, out of the hive path. mutate -- the decided change as an ordinary params update, hop.target naming the cell it is for; a parent wires one edge per cell the loop may reach, and a parent that wires none gets an argus that measures and receipts and changes nothing. slot_update -- the same for a text slot, applied only after an evaluation batch backed it. stats -- a question to a curator about its own ledger. eval -- a text change sent for evaluation before anything moves. alert -- a watched symptom crossed zero, deterministically and without a model: the metric, its count and the window. error -- a step of the cycle could not complete.
